name: Long Stretch
summary: Plank with hands on the footbar and feet against the shoulder blocks, moving the carriage from the shoulders.

layers.title: Knee plank
layers.text: Knees down on the carriage, small range.

layers.title: Full plank
layers.text: Move the carriage out and in from the shoulders.

cautions.note: Weight through the hands; offer forearms or swap.
Keep the range small; skip if painful.
Plank loads the abdominals later in pregnancy; offer knee plank or swap.

review.note: Starter entry written for OpenPilates. Needs review by a qualified Pilates instructor before teaching from it.
